title.en: Finding and checking a tenant

what: From the ad to the decision: write the ad, show the home, collect the applicant's details lawfully, check them, choose, and say no kindly. The site is never a broker.

title.en: The ad and the photos

what: A truthful ad with good photos, and a record of where it was published.

title.en: Write the ad with facts only

what: Write rooms, floor, size, street or neighbourhood, available date, rent and what is included. Leave out anything you cannot prove.
proof: the final text of the ad saved with the date

law.quote: המשכיר ימסור את המושכר כשהוא מתאים למוסכם בינו ובין השוכר

if_skipped: A tenant arrives to a home that is not as described; the match claim in the contract suffers.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): publish action (act_publish) in rm-views.js on a vacant unit; ad text not generated or checked

title.en: Put in the headline what people search for

what: Use the phrases people type for such a home (rooms, area). Before writing, do the manual Google search yourself (suggested keywords and the first results page) as the owner's search rule requires.
proof: the screenshots of the manual search kept in the research folder
if_skipped: The ad is hard to find.

title.he: ציינו מי משלם מה מעבר לשכר
title.en: State who pays what on top of the rent

what: Name arnona, water, electricity, gas and house-committee payments and who pays them, as the law sets for the tenancy period.
proof: the line in the ad
money: The tenant pays the items in section 25ט(א) for the tenancy period unless the contract says another valid way.

law.quote: השוכר יישא בתשלומים אלה לגבי תקופת השכירות

if_skipped: Questions and disputes on extra payments.

title.he: פרסמו רק מה שאתם יכולים להבטיח על המכשירים
title.en: Promise only the appliances you can stand behind

what: List in the ad only the appliances that stay and work.
proof: the list matches the appliance list in the file
if_skipped: A dispute at handover.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): appliances recorded; not linked to the ad text

title.en: Photograph every room in daylight

what: Take clear photos in daylight after cleaning: each room, the kitchen, the bathroom, the balcony, the entrance, the view.
proof: the photo set
if_skipped: Fewer enquiries; the ad looks like others.

title.en: Check there is no person in the photos

what: Photographing a person in his private domain without consent is an invasion of privacy. If the current tenant lives there, get consent or remove people and personal items from the frame.
proof: a check mark with the date

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: צילום אדם כשהוא ברשות היחיד

if_skipped: An invasion of privacy claim by the person photographed.

title.en: Keep discriminating wording out of the ad

what: Do not write who you will not rent to by religion, origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, family status, parenthood or the other listed grounds. See branch 02.06 for what the text covers.
proof: a check mark with the date

law.source: חוק איסור הפליה במוצרים, בשירותים ובכניסה למקומות בידור ולמקומות ציבוריים, התשס"א-2000
law.quote: לא יפרסם מודעה שיש בה משום הפליה אסורה

if_skipped: If the law applies to you, an ad with such wording is a civil wrong. Whether it applies to a private owner is not stated in the text I read.

title.en: Record where and when you published

what: Keep the links and dates of every place the ad appears so you can take it down when the home is let.
proof: a list of links with dates
if_skipped: An ad stays up after the home is let.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.en: Take the ad down when the home is let

what: Remove every ad you listed once a contract is signed.
proof: a tick per ad
if_skipped: Calls and wasted viewings continue.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.en: The viewing

what: Plan and run the viewings and keep a short record of who came.

title.en: Set viewing slots

what: Offer fixed slots (one group or separate), and tell each person the slot by message.
proof: a message per person with the date
if_skipped: Time is lost on scattered visits.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tasks table in inc/rentals/store.php can hold a reminder; no ready checklist for this step

title.en: Prepare a short folder for the viewing

what: Print or open: the appliance list, the known defects list, the extra payments list, the rent and the length of the lease.
proof: the folder checklist ticked
if_skipped: The same answers are given again and again, differently.

title.he: אם גר בה שוכר, תאמו מראש
title.en: If a tenant lives there, agree the time in advance

what: A tenant must let the landlord enter for inspection and repairs at a reasonable time with reasonable notice. Showing the home to a new tenant is not named in that section, so agree the visits in writing with the sitting tenant.
proof: the tenant's written reply

law.quote: זמן סביר מראש וימעיט ככל האפשר בהפרעה לשוכר
ללא הפרעה מצדו או מטעמו

if_skipped: The sitting tenant objects and a complaint on disturbance follows.

title.en: Show the known defects yourself

what: Point out the known defects at the viewing. A tenant who knew of a defect at signing cannot rely on it later; it also protects you.
proof: the applicant's signature or reply on the defects list

law.quote: השוכר ידע על אי־ההתאמה בעת כריתת חוזה השכירות

if_skipped: A later claim that the defect was hidden.

title.en: Record who came

what: Write the name and the date of each viewer only with his consent and for this purpose; do not copy ID cards at a viewing.
proof: a short list of names and dates

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: שימוש בידיעה על עניניו הפרטיים של אדם או מסירתה לאחר, שלא למטרה שלשמה נמסרה

if_skipped: Personal details are kept without a purpose.

title.he: שאלו מה חשוב לכל מבקר ושמרו תשובה
title.en: Ask each visitor what matters to him

what: After the viewing ask what he liked and what worried him; it helps your choice and your ad.
proof: a note per visitor

title.en: Collecting the applicant's details with consent

what: Collect only what you need, tell the applicant why, keep it safe and delete it when done. Text read: חוק הגנת הפרטיות (copy that includes amendment 13).

title.he: שלחו למועמד טופס עם הודעה על מטרת האיסוף
title.en: Send the applicant a form with the notice of purpose

what: When you ask a person for personal data to hold in a database, send with the request a notice that says: whether he must give it, the purpose, who controls the data, who will receive it and why, and his right to see and correct it.
when: before the applicant gives any detail
proof: the form sent with the date

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: פניה לאדם לקבלת מידע אישי לשם עיבודו במאגר מידע תלווה בהודעה

if_skipped: The notice duty is not met; whether a small owner's list is a data base in law is a question for a lawyer.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): the apply link (act_apply_link, inc/rentals/portal.php purpose 'apply') creates a prospect contact; not live for everyone

title.en: Ask only for what the choice needs

what: Write the list of details you will ask (name, contact, income evidence, previous landlord) and leave the rest out.
proof: the list of requested items

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: שימוש בידיעה על עניניו הפרטיים של אדם או מסירתה לאחר, שלא למטרה שלשמה נמסרה

if_skipped: Details collected without a need can be used out of purpose.

title.en: Make clear that giving the details is by consent

what: Write on the form that the applicant gives the details by choice and what happens if he does not (he may not be chosen).
proof: the sentence on the form

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: מסירת המידע תלויה ברצונו ובהסכמתו ומהי תוצאת אי־ההסכמה

if_skipped: The notice is incomplete.

title.he: סמנו מסמכי שכר וחשבון בנק כמידע רגיש
title.en: Mark pay and bank documents as sensitive

what: Pay data and financial activity are in the law's list of specially sensitive information. Keep them in one protected place, not in chats and not in a shared folder.
proof: documents stored in the protected place

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: מידע אישי על נתוני שכר של אדם ועל פעילותו הפיננסית

if_skipped: A leak is serious.

product_today.where: v2 (admin only): tenants' personal data encrypted at rest; no sensitivity mark on applicant documents

title.en: Keep the details secure

what: Keep applicants' documents in a place with a password; do not send them by open chat; limit who can see them.
proof: a note of where the details are kept

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: אחראי לאבטחת המידע שבמאגר המידע

if_skipped: Responsibility for a leak.

title.en: Answer a request to see the details

what: A person may ask to see the personal data held about him and to correct or delete it if wrong. Keep the reply ready.
proof: the reply with the date

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: כל אדם זכאי לעיין בעצמו

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: בבקשה לתקן את המידע האישי או למוחקו

if_skipped: A complaint to the Privacy Protection Authority.

title.en: Delete the details of applicants not chosen

what: Set a date after which you delete the details of those not chosen. I did not read a primary rule fixing how long; set your own short period and write it on the form.
proof: a deletion note with the date
if_skipped: Details are held with no purpose.

title.en: Checking the applicant

what: Identity, ability to pay, references, banking status. Every check is by the applicant's consent and by documents he gives you.

title.he: בדקו תעודת זהות מול הפנים בפגישה
title.en: Check the ID against the face at a meeting

what: Look at the ID in person, check the name and the number against the form, and note that you did, without keeping a copy unless the contract needs it.
proof: a tick with the date

law.quote: שמות הצדדים לחוזה, מספרי תעודת הזהות שלהם ומענם

if_skipped: The contract names the wrong person; the ID number is required in the contract.

title.he: בקשו תלושי שכר או הוכחת הכנסה אחרת

what: Ask the applicant to give payslips or other income evidence through the form with the privacy notice.
proof: the documents saved in the protected place

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: מידע אישי על נתוני שכר של אדם ועל פעילותו הפיננסית

title.he: בקשו דוח נתוני אשראי שהמועמד מביא בעצמו

what: A customer may get a free credit data summary from the Bank of Israel once a year. Ask him to bring it and share it of his own will; do not pull a report on another person.
proof: the report he gave you, if he chose to

law.quote: דוח ריכוז נתונים יימסר ללקוח בלא תשלום, לפי בקשתו, אחת לשנה

title.he: בדקו מול בנק ישראל אם החשבון מוגבל

when: before accepting a cheque as security
proof: a note of the result with the date

law.quote: מפרסם בנק ישראל באתר האינטרנט את רשימת החשבונות המוגבלים

proof: the form has no criminal-record question

title.en: Call the previous landlord with the applicant's consent

what: Ask the applicant for the previous landlord's contact and his OK to call. Ask only about rent paid on time, condition of the home and notice given.
proof: a note of the call with the date

law.source: חוק הגנת הפרטיות, התשמ"א-1981 (נוסח הכולל תיקון 13)
law.quote: שימוש בידיעה על עניניו הפרטיים של אדם או מסירתה לאחר, שלא למטרה שלשמה נמסרה

if_skipped: A choice with no reference.

title.he: בקשו אישור מעסיק רק אם המועמד מסכים

what: Ask for a short letter from the employer, given by the applicant.

title.he: ספרו למועמד מוקדם איזו ערובה תבקשו
title.en: Tell the applicant early what security you will ask

what: If you ask for security that costs the tenant money (a bank guarantee, a guarantee from another guarantor, cash), the total may not exceed the lower of two limits. Tell him the type and the amount up front.
proof: the message with the planned security
money: The limit is the lower of: the rent for one third of the lease period, or three monthly rents. The amount is computed from the contract's rent.

law.quote: לא יעלה גובהן המצטבר של הערובות על הנמוך מבין סכומים אלה
